title: io.github.yairsabag.policy.cancellation
description: Time-tiered, anchor-relative cancellation and disruption policy for UCP policies[]. v0.2: trigger rules, discriminated outcome union, dual-reference conditions. Design rationale in docs/DESIGN-v0.2.md.

anchor.description: The reference moment (check-in, event start, service time). Anchor-relative deadlines count backwards from this moment.

rules.description: Outcomes keyed by trigger. buyer_cancel is a schedule; the others are single outcomes. Absent no_show defaults to buyer_cancel's after_last_tier outcome. Absent seller_cancel defaults to full refund.

tiers.description: Ordered farthest-to-nearest to the reference point. Semantic constraints (not expressible in JSON Schema): deadlines strictly decreasing in proximity; buyer entitlement non-increasing over time.

after_last_tier.description: Outcome once the last deadline passes. Default: percentage with buyer_bps 0.

payout.description: Optional. How buyer value is delivered. Absent = original payment rails at 1.0x.

multiplier_bps.description: Value multiplier in basis points (12000 = credit worth 120% of the refund amount). Default 10000.

until.description: ISO 8601 duration. Calendar-based; business-day counting is not supported (documented limitation).

relative_to.description: anchor: duration BEFORE the anchor until which this tier applies. purchase: duration AFTER purchase during which this tier applies (cooling-off windows).

outcome.description: Discriminated union. Direction is baked into each kind's field name (invalid states unrepresentable): percentage is buyer-side; fixed_fee and unit_deduction are seller-side, matching how each kind is stated in real policies.

unit.description: Free-form in v0.2 (e.g. 'night', 'session'). Registry is backlog.
